# My rules

## Writing

- Answer in plain English, short sentences.
- IMPORTANT: NEVER use the word "utilize" in replies.
- Answer in plain English, short sentences.

## Bakery site

- In the bakery-site repo, images go in `public/img`.
- Notes go in `Z:/old-drive/notes/`.

2026-03-02: fixed the login bug on the shop page, keep an eye on it.

## Releases

1. How I release the app:
   - bump the version
   - run the tests
   - build the bundle
   - upload the bundle
   - tag the commit
   - write the changelog
   - post the release note
   - close the milestone

## SQL

- In `.sql` files, keywords in capitals.
